company.name: GeneralMind
company.tagline: Experience the power of Autonomous AI with GeneralMind
company.description:
GeneralMind is a Berlin-founded AI company building its own System of Action for modern enterprises; an operational AI layer on top of ERP systems. This is not a copilot. It’s an autopilot: human-supervised, with approvals where needed. 

Our AI Autopilot autonomously executes recurring, complex workflows end-to-end across email, Excel, and enterprise systems. Incoming tasks are captured, analyzed, and completed with human-level capability, tracking handovers, meeting deadlines, and ensuring compliance across multiple stakeholders.

Designed for mid-sized and large enterprises, GeneralMind helps organizations eliminate inbox-driven work, improve execution across goods and money flows, and keep supply chains moving at scale.

Founded in 2025, GeneralMind serves customers across industry, commerce, and logistics in Europe and beyond.
